jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer – CX1 Sigma
jobs_results.description:
Job Category: Software R&D
Job Types: Full Time
Job Locations: Hyderabad
About Unilog
Unilog is the only connected product content and eCommerce provider serving the Wholesale Distribution, Manufacturing, and Specialty Retail industries. Our flagship CX1 Platform is at the center of some of the most successful digital transformations in North America. CX1 Platform’s syndicated product content, integrated eCommerce storefront, and automated PIM tool simplify our customers’ path to success in the digital marketplace.


With more than 500 customers, Unilog is uniquely positioned as the leader in eCommerce and product content for Wholesale distribution, manufacturing, and specialty retail.


Unilog’s Mission Statement
At Unilog, our mission is to provide purpose-built connected product content and eCommerce solutions that empower our customers to succeed in the face of intense competition. By virtue of living our mission, we are able to transform the way Wholesale Distributors, Manufacturers, and Specialty Retailers go to market. We help our customers extend a digital version of their business and accelerate their growth.


Job Title: Software Engineer- Frontend


Location: Hyderabad (Work from Office)


Experience: 2 to 5 years


Department: Software R&D


No. of Positions: 1


Job Synopsis
We are looking for a Frontend Developer with 2+ years of experience to build fast, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces for our B2B eCommerce platform.


Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain UI components and pages using Vue.js, JavaScript, and jQuery.
Build responsive, mobile-first layouts with HTML5 and Tailwind CSS.
Integrate frontend screens with backend REST APIs.
Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into pixel-accurate, reusable components.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and consistent behavior across devices.
Debug issues and contribute to page-load and rendering performance optimization.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD workflows.
Collaborate with product, design, backend, and QA teams.
Use AI tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor effectively for development and productivity.
Required Skills
2+ years of experience in frontend development.
Strong knowledge of Vue.js (components, directives, state management, routing).
Strong JavaScript (ES6+) fundamentals, including DOM, events, and async programming.
Hands-on experience with jQuery.
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and Tailwind CSS.
Strong experience building responsive, mobile-first web interfaces.
Experience consuming REST APIs and handling JSON data.
Good understanding of browser debugging tools, cross-browser issues, and web performance.
Familiarity with Git, npm, and build tools such as Vite or Webpack.
Good understanding of clean coding practices and reusable component design.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Good hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude.
Good to Have
Experience in B2B eCommerce, product catalog, or search-driven storefronts.
Exposure to Vue 3 Composition API, Pinia, or TypeScript.
Experience with Nuxt.js, including server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation.
Ability to exemplify the core Unilog Company values:
Curiosity: Be passionate about achieving excellence. Learn every day.
Conscience: Be caring of others. Act with integrity.
Courage: Be brave. Pursue outrageous goals.
Compete: Be fair. Play to win.
Courtesy: Be humble. Serve customers.
Commitment: Be accountable. Own your results.
About our Benefits:
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunities for professional development and hands-on training in cutting-edge AI technologies.
Collaborative, innovative, and forward-thinking work environment.
Comprehensive health and wellness programs.
Unilog is committed to building the best team and we are committed to fair hiring practices where we hire people for their potential and advocate for diversity, equity, and inclusion. As such, we do not discriminate or make decisions based on your race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, sex, national origin, age, disability, familial status, marital status, military status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression, or any other protected class.

jobs_results.description:
Job Summary   
We are looking for an experienced React / Next.js Developer to join our digital team and take ownership of developing and maintaining our corporate website and related web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong front-end expertise combined with experience in deployment pipelines, CMS integration (Contentful), and contemporary development practices to deliver a seamless and high-performing user experience.  

Must Have Skills (Mandatory)  
Strong proficiency in React.js, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS  
Experience in developing responsive, SEO-friendly, and accessible web pages aligned with brand and UX guidelines  
Proven experience in integrating and managing headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful  
Hands-on experience with API integration, authentication mechanisms, and web security best practices  
Experience in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools  
Familiarity with version control systems (Git), Docker, and cloud deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Vercel  
Ability to collaborate effectively with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and product managers to deliver functional, scalable solutions  

Good to Have Skills (Optional)  
Experience with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Styled Components  
Knowledge of Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) in Next.js  
Familiarity with analytics and SEO optimization tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and similar platforms  
Experience working with design tools like Figma and integrating design systems  
Robust debugging, performance optimization, and problem-solving abilities  

Qualifications & Experience  
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field  
3 to 6 years of experience in front-end web development using React.js and Next.js  
Demonstrated experience in building and deploying corporate or marketing websites with headless CMS integrations  
Robust understanding of modern DevOps workflows, CI/CD best practices, and cloud-based deployment environments  
Passion for delivering clean, maintainable, and user-focused digital experiences .

jobs_results.job_title: Front End Developer - HTML and CSS
jobs_results.description:
About the Role
The Frontend Software will be tasked with crafting and enhancing the visual and interactive elements of web applications. This role involves using Angular along with other web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create responsive designs and integrate APIs. The developer will ensure cross-browser compatibility, optimize application performance, and maintain code quality through rigorous testing and documentation. This position requires staying updated with the latest in web development trends and technologies.


Role & responsibilities


Angular Development: Write clean and efficient code for web applications using Angular frameworks along with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
UI/UX Implementation: Convert design wireframes into interactive, functional web interfaces ensuring a seamless user experience.
Cross-Browser Compatibility: Guarantee consistent behavior and appearance of applications across various browsers.
API Integration: Work with backend APIs to fetch and display data effectively.
Performance Optimization: Enhance web application performance focusing on reducing load times and refining code.
Responsive Design: Develop responsive web designs to ensure optimal viewing across multiple devices.
Version Control: Utilize Git for efficient code management and team collaboration.
Documentation: Create detailed documentation related to code and development workflows.
Problem Solving: Identify and troubleshoot front end issues and bugs, proposing technical solutions when necessary.
Continuous Learning: Stay abreast of the latest industry trends in web development, including updates in technologies like Angular.


Preferred candidate profile


Experience: Minimum of 3 years in Angular-based frontend development.
Technical Skills: Proficient in Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery, and other modern JavaScript frameworks.
Agile Proficiency: Experienced with Agile and Scrum methodologies to enhance project delivery and efficiency.
Cross-Platform Coding: Skilled in writing code that works uniformly across different browsers and devices.
CI/CD Experience: Familiar with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems for streamlined development and deployment.
SEO Knowledge: Understands SEO principles and applies them to ensure enhanced application visibility.
Version Control and Databases: Proficient with Git and databases such as MySQL and MongoDB.
Independence and Proactivity: Capable of working independently and proactively to meet tight deadlines.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.
Innovative Approach: Able to introduce new technologies and practices to address business challenges and improve development processes. .
